company.name: Rolodoc
company.one_liner: A social network where doctors and patients connect and share information.

facts.summary: Two physician brothers built a website that helps doctors find and message each other and lets patients look up doctors.
highlights: Doctors can message each other and share information securely.
Big medical networks and websites already exist.

real_deal.summary: No deal. Every shark was out, and Mark Cuban called it one of the worst pitches he'd seen.

outcome.headline: The founders went back to medicine, and the site went offline.
outcome.story: After the show the founders stepped away from the project. The website and app went offline around 2014, and the company is defunct.
